start: Profile > Body, the Body weight chip, at least two weigh-ins in History

steps.action: Open Body from Profile and pick the Body weight chip
user_sees: Screen titled 'Body'
History heading with 'Tap an entry to fix or delete it.'
must_not: A gym-recorded entry offered for editing

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Fix this weigh-in' with the value and the day
must_not: A different entry opened than the one tapped

user_sees: The sheet closes
History and the graph show 79.5 on that day
must_not: The old value still shown on Home or Progress
A second entry made on that day

start: Body > Body weight, two weigh-ins on different days

steps.action: Open a weigh-in and change its day to a day that already has a weigh-in, tap Save
user_sees: Question '<day> already has Body weight <value>' with 'Replace it with this one?' and a red 'Replace' button
must_not: The other day's entry replaced without asking

user_sees: One entry on the new day with the new value
Bar 'Replaced the entry on <day>' with 'Undo'
must_not: Two entries on one day
The edited entry left on its old day too

user_sees: The edited entry back on its old day with its old value, and the replaced entry back
must_not: The replaced entry lost for good

start: Progress photos screen, a photo with a wrong date

steps.action: Open Progress photos from Body ('See all'), open a photo and change its date
user_sees: A day picker that does not offer a day after today
must_not: A future day accepted

user_sees: The photo shows the new date and moves to its place in the list
must_not: The photo lost or duplicated
The old date still shown on the Body strip

start: Body > Body weight, the fix sheet of one weigh-in is open

steps.action: Clear the value (or type 0) and tap Save
user_sees: Red line 'Type a number above 0, like 82.5.'
must_not: The entry saved as 0 or empty

steps.action: Type a far-off value such as 8 instead of 80 and tap Save
user_sees: A typo question with 'Keep it' and 'Fix it'
must_not: A tenfold jump saved without a question

steps.action: Look at an entry the gym recorded
user_sees: History line 'Tap your own entry to fix or delete it. Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: The gym's entry opened for edit or delete

start: Body > Body weight, the fix sheet of one weigh-in is open

user_sees: The entry leaves History
Bar 'Weigh-in on <day> deleted' with 'Undo'
must_not: The entry gone with no way back
A delete question that hides the Undo

user_sees: Bar '2 changes to your measures' with 'Undo all'
must_not: Only the last delete undone by 'Undo all'

user_sees: Both entries back with their values and days
must_not: The bar closing while an entry stays deleted and nothing is said

start: Member who joined a gym; Body weight and progress photos on the phone

steps.action: Fix a weigh-in, then open Settings > Your gym > What my gym can see
user_sees: Words that MettleUp never sends body weight, photos or notes
must_not: Body weight in anything the gym, a trainer or gym mates can see

user_sees: The photo only on this phone
must_not: The photo uploaded to the server or the cloud copy
